sys.title: Systems
sys.desc: Internal platforms and tools we delivered.

projects.title: AFTERSALES PROCESS INTEGRATION
projects.lead: We have successfully designed, developed, and rolled out our integrated aftersales workflow. Every step has been mapped, responsibilities clarified, and handoffs refined — creating a unified process that ensures consistency, efficiency, and a smoother experience for both our teams and our customers.
caps: Successfully mapped and streamlined the complete workflow
Defined clear steps from inquiry through to resolution

projects.title: OFFICIAL MEMO RELEASE
projects.lead: We formally released and circulated key operational documents to all relevant teams: our updated process flow, the 7-Day Replacement Policy for items received damaged, guidelines for Out-of-Warranty cases, and the Change Item policy. These official memos establish clear, consistent procedures, ensure everyone follows the same standards, and serve as a reliable reference for daily operations.
caps: Released updated process flow as an official addendum
Issued 7-Day Replacement Policy for Damaged Items Upon Delivery
Distributed Change Item policy to all concerned teams

projects.title: PROCESS ROLLOUT & IMPLEMENTATION
projects.lead: We successfully rolled out and implemented our updated process across the organization. Through team sessions and collaborative discussions, everyone was aligned on the new standards and workflows — turning our plans into consistent action and unified service delivery.
caps: Conducted sessions to ensure full understanding
Guided everyone through the new workflows
Transitioned smoothly to our improved standards

projects.title: SALES DEPARTMENT ALIGNMENT
projects.lead: We successfully gathered the sales department — both in-person and through virtual attendance — to ensure everyone is fully aligned. This session helped clarify expectations, share important updates, and make sure every team member works toward the same goals with consistent standards.
caps: Brought the sales team together — both in-person and online
Shared updates, clarified goals, and aligned on standards
Connected across locations for one clear direction
